name: 話題を添えた代表的な口コミ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0029 話題を添えた代表的な口コミ. Treat this as a minimal white-card styling edit around protected source media. ORIGINAL priority: input1 original review crop controls avatar photo, chevron geometry, proportions and fine details. Input2 exact original avatar crop is PROTECTED MEDIA: reuse the identical real black-and-white photo and circular crop; do not regenerate the person's face, glasses, hair, clothing or background. Input3 native mock is secondary Japanese content/layout; retain its saved Japanese wording. Input4 approved bus is STYLE ONLY. Input5 original full screenshot is context, not a whole-screen recreation.
One compact horizontal white rounded review card, pure-white #FFFFFF canvas, fine neutral border, restrained soft downward shadow. Left small circular avatar from EXACT source photo, center Japanese quote in regular weight, below a metadata line, right original narrow right-pointing chevron in slate #526173. Align avatar with quote body and chevron to row center; metadata aligned to quote column, not avatar. No heading or added control.
Exact quote: "「友人とゆっくり過ごせる、気持ちのよい公園です。」". Natural two-line wrapping without splitting a character or clipping. Exact secondary line: "129人が休憩について言及". No invented reviewer name, star rating, dates or counts. Preserve the catalog's Japanese localized wording; do not translate the original English differently.
Accent decision: no selected state or primary action exists; keep neutral text and coherent slate chevron, source photograph stays black-and-white. No green icon, green avatar ring, colored initial fallback, mint fill or random accent. Meiryo bodyRegular40014/24, metadataRegular12/16,tracking0; ink#1D1D1D secondary#6E6E6E. Compact balanced card about3:1 width-to-height with modest white margins. Original avatar must remain the same photo at small size, not an illustrated or newly generated substitute. Do not include surrounding reviews, charts, device, navigation or logos.
reviewNotes: Full original, distinct review/avatar crops, native mock and output visually examined. Saved Japanese quote and129人が休憩について言及 retained; regular text, two-line wrap and slate right-chevron checked. Original blackwhite portrait remains visibly the same face/glasses/white background marker and circular photo; enlargement/resampling visible, no pixel-identical media claim. Saved Japanese休憩 is existing localized adaptation of original blanket, not a verified literal translation. No functional accent introduced; white rounded card, neutral metadata. Agent-reviewed raster candidate only, no owner approval/native editability/application behavior.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
